source: Claude Certified Architect – Professional Exam Guide, Version 1.0, effective July 2026

tasks.title: Translate business problems into Claude-based AI solutions
skills: Quantify the actual bottleneck before selecting an architecture

tasks.title: Design end-to-end architectures (input → processing → output → feedback loops)

tasks.title: Select appropriate architectural patterns (workflow, agentic, augmented LLM)

tasks.title: Design multi-agent systems and orchestration strategies
skills: Design coordination to prevent duplication and races

tasks.title: Apply decomposition techniques for complex problem solving

tasks.title: Design system prompts, templates, and guardrails

tasks.title: Optimize context windows and manage token usage
